profile_text.body:
InVideo is a video creation platform accessible at invideo.io. The company offers an AI-powered tool it calls Agent Two, which it describes as enabling users to create and edit AI-generated videos through a conversational interface rather than manual configuration.

The company describes Agent Two as maintaining long-term memory of a project's full context so that consistency is preserved across clips without repeated instructions. It also describes the system as handling model selection and prompt writing on behalf of the user, positioning the product toward people who want to direct creative output without configuring AI systems directly.

The site's held facts list InVideo under the video generation and editing category, with the main invideo.io product noted for video generation. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company.
